title: Polynomial-time biased randomized languages
statement: For a real number $\rho$, define the class of biased randomized polynomial-time languages as the union, over all natural numbers $c$, of the classes decidable with bias parameter $\rho$ and time bound $n^c+1$.
caveat: The definition of $\mathrm{biasedBPTIME}$ is not included, so the exact meaning of its bias parameter and time bound cannot be made self-contained.
